notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi (chrome124 impersonation) fetch of https://www.kmart.com.au/ succeeded (200); __NEXT_DATA__ (props.navigationProps.staticHeaderData) embeds the full live nav taxonomy including a dedicated top-level Home & Living > Pets branch (id 750e92a6a691645ba02c20d6620583e0, count=5199) with real child groups Dog / Cat / Fish plus standalone leaves Pet Tech and Pet Wellness. Same Constructor.io public search key found by the prior Home-Decor pass (key_GZTqlLr41FS2p7AY) was reused to hit ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<id> (not behind Kmart's Akamai) for every leaf; each returned total_num_results identical to the nav's own 'count' field (19 leaves cross-checked). Boundary-verified Dog Toys (id 3aa43770744ebe97923ac8a823b43f8a, total=113): page 5 (rows 97-113) returned the exact 17-item remainder and page 6 returned 0 - confirms totals are exact, not inflated. EXCLUDED as navigation/marketing pages per Rule 4: 'Pets Latest Arrivals' (135), 'Pets Best Sellers' (28), 'Pets Clearance' (186). DUPLICATE MENU PLACEMENT: 'Pet Travel' (/category/home-and-living/pet-travel-supplies-and-accessories/, count=16) appears identically under both the Dog children list (id 54149d6ddc414ed9c2407e92c2839628) and the Cat children list (id f174fbbba44152f8914deda3d26084cf) - same URL and same count, so recorded once as its own leaf directly under the Pets grouping rather than duplicated under Dog and Cat. GROUP NODES: Dog (925), Cat (250) and Fish (27) are genuine parent nodes whose own aggregate counts include additional un-subcategorized items beyond their listed children (e.g. Dog children sum to 599 vs parent 925) - recorded as is_group rows with qty/link null per the no-double-count rule; their real children are the leaf rows immediately following. CONTENT CHECKS: sampled item titles for every leaf via the Constructor.io results payload to confirm pet-specific composition (not pet-themed goods) - e.g. Dog Beds returns 'Pet Bed Orthopaedic...', Aquariums returns '20L Aquarium Starter Kit', Pet Tech returns 'Pet Water Fountain'/'Pet Treat Dispenser'/'Pet LED Safety Necklace'. FLAGGED PET CONSUMABLE per brief's open policy gap: Dog Treats (65, dog jerky/liver treats), Cat Food (9, cat treat/puree sachets), Fish Food (3, Vitapet fish flake food) - genuine consumable categories, recorded not dropped. Pet Wellness (17) sampled as mostly pet wipes/orthopaedic beds/feed sets with one supplement-like item ('Calming Bites') - left unflagged as the category is overwhelmingly Tier-1 grooming/hygiene/bedding, not primarily medical or consumable. No medical/veterinary (medicine, prescription, clinical) category was found on the site. No other Pet Care presence found outside the Home & Living > Pets branch (checked full nav tree for 'pet' keyword; only unrelated hits were 'Petite' womenswear and 'Little Live Pets' toys, both correctly out of scope).
